title: Figure 1: Specific Energy for Chemical, Nuclear, and Antimatter Materials – bar chart
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale of energy density in MJ/μg (1.00E-08 to 1.00E+03) for four categories: Chemical, Fission, Fusion and Positron Annihilation, with positron annihilation highest. The caption reads "Figure 1. Specific Energy for Chemical, Nuclear, and Antimatter Materials." The page opens an "Antimatter" section discussing positronium and annihilation energy for aerospace propulsion.
